svg.desc: Upper Egypt Local Development Program LOCATION Sohag - Minya - Assyut, Qena Governorates, Egypt CLIENT Upper Egypt Local Development Plan Coordination Office (UELDP) Funded by: World Bank STATUS EST. VALUE In Progress 23.7 billion EGP DISCIPLINES Urban Planning & Design Landscape Design Architectural Design Project Overview This ongoing project across Minya, Assiut, Sohag, and Qena supports the World Bank and Government of Egypt's UELDP by enhancing local administration's capacity for integrated urban and rural development. BECT provides technical support in urban planning and design, including service design guidelines, intervention prioritization, execution supervision for sixprojects, and capacity building for local departments.
